hypothesis: W-R28B acceleration reduced error on quadratic-irregular raw data but remained far from perfect. Freeze a direct generator-factor ablation: remove only a bounded modular 19 irregularity term and test whether second-order finite-difference prediction recovers the underlying quadratic law.
family_definitions: quadratic_irregular: pure_quadratic+7*((s+c)*t mod19) mod256, exact W-R20
inputs: Four raw byte channels per tick, candidate global offset+79, real per-tick/each-channel jitter amplitudes1,3,5 with exact bounded W-R28B formula. Predictor at t in2..14 sees only candidate t,t-1,t-2; hidden observed t+1 enters scoring only.
metrics: Each of 4 generator families x3 amplitudes x3 predictors: heldout circular MAE and within8/exact-byte rate over all four channels, per-seed results and checks that irregular sequence equals pure plus only specified term.
classification: IRREGULARITY_BOUNDARY iff at amp3 pure_quadratic acceleration MAE<=20 and irregular acceleration MAE exceeds pure by>=15 and affine velocity MAE<=10; PARTIAL iff irregular exceeds pure by>=10 but strict boundary fails; NEGATIVE otherwise. Retain all negative controls and never select favorable amp post-result.
controls: No learned parameter fitting on exposed heldout, no future target in input, same noise for paired pure/irregular
Exact W-R28B source identity/prereg prior to original experiment
One first-use archive and final full Go regression
No new model weights or accepted-ref mutation, no first-use retries
claim_limit: Synthetic structural recurrence ablation, not learned general reasoning.
